resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's Built field says 1932, while its description says constructed circa 1932-1934. The story gives 1932 as the build year and notes the wider range.

The register credits the Bureau of Biological Survey with construction but also says Gayer Dominick owned the island until 1936. Neither source I could read explains how a federal bureau built on the island before the transfer. Not resolved; the story reports it as open.

sources.title: Welcome to Bulls Island at Cape Romain National Wildlife Refuge

notes_for_editor: The NHLR detail page is the main source. The FWS visitor guide gives island access and describes a 16-foot observation tower near the public dock, far shorter than the 110-foot lookout. Wikipedia is used only for the boat-access and ferry claims, which are not checked against the ferry operator. The Forest Lookouts page has only a header and no narrative. No staffing or fire history was found. No source says whether the public may climb the tower, so no access level is recorded. The NHLR's construction-by-Bureau-of-Biological-Survey claim versus the 1936 transfer is unresolved and needs a 1930s refuge history. The NHLR photo credit (Sarah Dawsey) has no image URL in the cache, so no photo is recorded.
